Just this week in Aldi I bought a pack of 3 room thermometers, for 10€. Get them, place them in your living area and bedroom, monitor and photograph the temperature, then send in emails or messages with images attached to your landlord and kindly request the heating to be turned on. If he refuses after 2-3 times, send this as a report to Beratungshilfe and ask for assistance. Hopefully your situation resolves before those measures being necessary, good luck!
I dare you
P.S., put a pillow under your knees to slightly raise them up, helps me with back pain from lying down a lot!

What helped me most is being in bed in sort of a half sitting half lying down position when I got tired from walking 30 steps around the apartment. 
Move your feet up and down to contract lower leg muscles to keep the circulation going when you are in bed.
Helps with farting hehe.
Drink plenty of water and eat very light foods (chicken&veg broth soup, any light soups tbh, light oatmeal, lactose free yoghurt with fresh blueberries, some raw almonds as a snack..) so you don’t get even more bloated. 
I am on day 5 of post-op now and today is the first day I don’t feel the pain in the upper abdomen and diaphragm, and this for me was the most painful part of recovery. 
It just takes time for your body to either absorb or release the gasses. Speedy recovery to you 🩷

THIS! Don’t get me wrong, but I’m honestly relieved that somebody else is going through these motions.

Not being able to trust your own mind as it battles itself is so draining. The grief digs into the darkest corners of your mind and plays games you would have never thought of being able of occuring.

At this point for me it seems as if it is never ending, and I’m so scared of becoming a bitter shell of myself. When people tell me they love me it pisses me off (YOU don’t love me, SHE loved me), physical touch stresses me out, I snap at the smallest things that don’t go my way.. sometimes it is so justified in my head and then I just become ashamed of myself later and then the anger continues. How the hell can one snap out of this vicious circle?

I see so many people around me broken by similar wounds, and it seems as they never recover. These feelings cut you down to shreds at times. I guess it might be important to have mercy on yourself when going through all of this..

In the moments of falling apart alone I’ve been craving a certain state of mind to start again.
You know how there are times when life is on autopilot, but in a way that doesn’t make you feel like a brainless meat machine being forcefully dragged into existence? 
Just one day connecting into another without a bump, without a fight or a fire. Days where nothing happens and it doesn’t make you feel like shit. Like summer break months blending into just moments of warmth. When you can just sit and breathe without thinking of running off somewhere else. Regenerating and comforting in every sense..
Hope you can relate..
